summary: Foresight Autonomous Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 24, 2026, reporting that it has entered into a Proof-of-Concept agreement with a leading European car manufacturer to validate its stereo vision AI-based solution for off-road driving scenarios. The filing describes a development and demonstration POC, not a merger, acquisition, tender, or other special situation. No financial terms, ownership changes, or shareholder action are involved. This is a routine business development press release furnished as a foreign private issuer report. There are no deal terms, no board recommendation, and no transaction mechanics to analyze.
